## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `ff794532f8e0b3ec35ace2a7428112e6c522d75d` · 2026-11-25T20:02Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the committed tree at head, not against the dev report (7172557196). Net diff read in full: +769/−133 across 12 files, merge-base `fbb62e1cca98`.

### Checklist

- **Shape.** Open, draft, base `main`, `mergeable_state` clean. The first line is `Fixes #37201`. `l1-face.mjs --pr 37341` reads ok on shape, first-line, relation, releases-path, changeset, empty-changeset, nul-suspects, declarations, skills-docs, floor-checks and dogfood. It flags two items, both read below: keywords-other-cards (`Fixes #37211`, intended) and all-checks (a superseded run).
- **Closing keywords.**
  - `Fixes #37201` (line 1): the PR delivers every item in the card's What list (1–7) and its Done-when list (see "Card met" below). F1–F3 are filed "when this card lands" (card Notes), so they are a landing duty, not part of this delivery.
  - `Fixes #37211` (line 2): the card's Fix says it "closes when #37201 lands, with a `~org` case in `StudioMenu.test.tsx` asserting no count above Organization flows". That case is in the PR at `StudioMenu.test.tsx` (`~org and ~all draw no fold`, the `#37211` assertions), and it goes red on ablation (X1 below).
  - The body's other match is in the PM note, in backticks, and names the same card (#37211).
  - No closing keyword sits next to any other card number.
- **Card met: #37201, the order table.** `buildStudioMenu` sorts each group's types by row index in `STUDIO_MENU_PLACEMENT`. The sort is stable, so an unplaced type follows the placed ones in served order.
  - It stamps `tier` from the row, `advanced` when a type has no row.
  - The four non-type entries are stamped `advanced` and pushed after the types of their group.
  - `STUDIO_MENU_ALWAYS_TYPES` is derived from the table's `common` rows.
  - The table itself is untouched apart from its doc comment (the #37232 L1 N1 carry). Its rows equal ruling 7151834490 and the adjustments in 7151811337:
    - 常用 in this order: 对象 · 应用, 页面, 仪表盘, 报表 · 流程 · 权限集 · 智能体, 工具, 技能.
    - 选项列表, 邮件模板 and 默认共享 are in 高级.
    - AI is the last 常用 group (`STUDIO_MENU_GROUPS` order; 平台 holds no 常用 row).
  - `StudioMenu.tsx`:
    - Group labels are muted, with no count, no link and nothing focusable.
    - Item counts are muted, with the new test id `studio-menu-count-KEY`.
    - An empty 常用 entry is dimmed, shows no number and stays a link.
    - The fold: a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, closed by default, writes only `studio_menu_advanced` and only on a click. It opens itself on a 高级 current entry without writing the cookie.
    - A search lists entries flat, and `~org` / `~all` are flat with no fold.
  - ⌘K: `studioPaletteModel.ts` and `StudioPaletteGroups.tsx` are not in the diff; only the palette's test expectations moved.
  - The group-count test id is the only test id removed. Entry test ids, entry keys and `to` addresses are unchanged (also pinned: `keeps every address and entry key`).
  - `studioMenuModel.test.ts:64` is rewritten on purpose and named so in the body.
- **Zone rulings.**
  - Q2 A (`countsAnswered` = settled ∧ ¬sweep error) matches the card's "the sweep answered with none". It is pinned, and it goes red on ablation (X3).
  - Q1 A and Q3 A are read under "Claim lines" and N1.
- **Scope.** All 12 paths are inside #37201's claimed file surface (7169088969): menu model, view, data, placement doc comment, studio en/zh, changeset, and the menu's tests. That includes the e2e spec and two neighbouring test files whose expectations the change moves; the body names each one. No `content/docs/releases/` path, and no governed path.
- **i18n.**
  - `released-keys-removed.mjs --tag @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0`, read-only from git: 77 keys absent at merge-base `fbb62e1c` and the same 77 at head `ff794532` (`comm` of the two sorted lists is empty). The PR removes no released key. The 77 are pre-existing on main and are retired by `.changeset/37223-…`.
  - Two keys were added, `engine.studio.menu.advanced` and `engine.studio.menu.emptyType`, in `studio/en.ts` and `studio/zh.ts`. They need no other language: the `studio` namespace ships en and zh by ruling (objectstack#25922, 6431032267, header of `namespaces/studio/index.ts`). It sits outside `locales/` and `all-locales-key-parity` by construction, so the 11-pack rule does not reach it. Its own parity (en ⊆ zh) holds.
- **Declarations and changeset levels.**
  - `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear in the PR body and in `.changeset/37201-studio-menu-tiers.md`; `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` give the same reading of each.
  - `no` is right:
    - `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, and none of the menu symbols is on its `exports` (the rename `STUDIO_MENU_DESIGNER_TYPES` → `STUDIO_MENU_ALWAYS_TYPES` has zero remaining references in the tree).
    - The studio catalogue is typed `Readonly<Record<string, string>>`, so its two added keys widen no exported type.
    - No metadata author surface changes, so `none`.
  - Both packages are at `patch`, which `Metadata-protocol: none` requires. The `@object-ui/i18n` entry covers its two changed files.
- **Changeset, read sentence by sentence against the diff.** Every sentence holds:
  - ten Common types in building order;
  - the four non-type entries and every other type under one Advanced button below a divider;
  - closed by default, remembered in `studio_menu_advanced`, apart from the collapse cookie;
  - the self-open leaves the remembered state alone;
  - search spans both tiers;
  - muted, numberless group names;
  - an empty Common type dimmed, numberless and a link, and not dimmed before counts load;
  - `~org` / `~all` flat;
  - no address change;
  - two new strings.

  One wording note is N2.
- **Contract review: not owed.** None of the four faces is touched. Clause-② is `no` with no `(narrowing)` arm. `reviewFace` on the 12 paths gives `hits` `{schema: [], rules: []}`; with the declarations read in, its face answer is `declaration` / `TIER_DEFAULT`, but that face is owed only by a `Clause-②: yes` line, which this PR does not carry. No record is written.

### Claim lines (seat-side read)

The newest `Claim:` on each card, read through `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` at head), agrees with the PR body and the changeset:

| Carrier | `Clause-②` | `Metadata-protocol` |
|---|---|---|
| #37201 claim 7169088969 | declared `no`, no arm | declared `none` |
| #37211 claim 7172656271 | declared `no`, no arm | declared `none` |
| PR body | declared `no`, no arm | declared `none` |
| changeset | declared `no`, no arm | declared `none` |

#37211's claim names `claude/issue-37201-studio-menu-tiers`, the PR's head ref; that is the Q1 A ruling as carried. No seat-side item.

### Gates at head (check-runs, read directly)

- 62 runs on `ff794532`. Taking the newest per name: 43 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed. l1-face reads 0 unexpected skips. The floor checks, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check, are both `success`. Test UI (16/16), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate and Governed Surface Queue Guard are green.
- **PR-body guards:** run 139447224940 (2026-11-25T19:11Z, suite 123604821218) failed. It is superseded by 139465661537 (2026-11-25T19:43Z, suite 123618930985), which is `success`.
- **Check Changeset finished green:** the re-run 139465661408 started 2026-11-25T19:43Z and completed `success` at 2026-11-25T19:45Z. The earlier run 139447221820 was also `success`.
- Check PR Size: the edit-triggered run skipped; the push run (139447222061) was `success`.

### Pins and ablations, re-run by the seat

- **Setup.** A throwaway worktree at `ff794532` under the scratchpad. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline --ignore-scripts`, store-backed. JS-only builds (`OS_SKIP_DTS=1`) of `@objectstack/spec`, `formula`, `client` and `core`, the packages the two suites resolve. Removed afterwards.
- **Unmutated:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run …/studioMenuModel.test.ts …/StudioMenu.test.tsx` gives 2 files, **45 passed (45)** (23 + 22), matching the report's 45.
- **Ablations.** Each went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which reported "ok mutation landed" (anchor 1 → 0) and "ok restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty". `git diff --quiet HEAD` was checked after each one.

| # | Mutation | Result | Dev row |
|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | a type count put back into the group label (the pre-PR `Automation0` shape) | **3 failed**: the muted-heading case, plus the `~org` and `~all` cases, which carry the #37211 assertion | #37211 pin, not a row in the dev's table |
| X2 | `advancedOpen = remembered` (no self-open) | **2 failed**: the bookmark to 钩子, and closing on a 高级 page | A13: 2 ✓ |
| X3 | `countsAnswered: (settled)` (a failed sweep counts as answered) | **1 failed**: "a sweep that failed answered nothing" | A6: 1 ✓ |
| X4 | no sort by the placement table | **4 failed** (order, tiers split, `~org`, `~all`) | A1: 4 ✓ |

The first attempt at X1 and X3 was refused by the tool, because the replacement contained the anchor (the same trap the dev logged). Those attempts are not counted; the rows above are the re-spelled runs.

### Merge, overlap, K

- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main ff794532` (main `a182fbe3`): clean, exit 0.
- **#37338** (head `97fa2d83`, draft, touches `PackagesPage.tsx`, `PackageFormDialog.tsx` and their tests): no shared code file with this PR. It shares only `studio/en.ts` and `studio/zh.ts`, in different regions (`engine.packages.create.*` against `engine.studio.menu.*`). Merge-tree is clean pairwise, and clean on top of main ⊕ #37341. `overlap-check.mjs --branch=ff794532 --base=origin/main`: "VERDICT clean exit 0", with #37338 the only open PR sharing a file. #37315 has merged.
- **K = 10.** `landing-k.mjs` cannot answer: the PR is UI-only, and no Test Core shard printed an `Affected-set diff base`. So K was read by hand: `git rev-list --first-parent --count fbb62e1c..origin/main` = 10.
  - Locale leg: not a display-label PR. No `translations/` bundle or `locales/` pack is in the diff, and no new language pack landed on main after the base.
  - Shared-budget leg: no `skills/**` and no `ui/**/locales/en.ts` in the diff.
  - Both legs are clear.

### 维护者速读

Accurate. Every line matches the diff:
- the ten 常用 entries in the ruled order;
- 「高级」 closed by default at the bottom;
- group names in small grey type with no number, and an entry's grey number counting its items;
- a new empty package shows the 应用、页面、仪表盘、报表 entries;
- only order and folding change, with every address unchanged;
- a single-PR revert.

「要你做什么：无」 is right: the PR is not governed, its 902 lines are under 3,000, it is Tier S, and no contract review is owed.

### Findings

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N1 — the `typeCount` acceptance note misstates the release status.** The PR body says `engine.studio.menu.typeCount` "ships in the released `@object-ui/i18n` catalogue", but the key is in no `@object-ui/i18n` release tag: 18.6.0, the latest and the tag `released-keys-removed.mjs` reads, lacks it. It came in with #36985 (2026-11-24T17:04Z).
  - Keeping it is still right, because #37201 is additive-only.
  - The Q3 retirement card should record that this key is not a released key. Removing it then needs no released-key process.
  - The seat may correct the line in the PR body.
- **N2 — ⌘K gains entries.** The changeset's "the ⌘K palette lists the same entries in the new order", and the 速读, which leaves ⌘K out, both understate one visible change. On a package, ⌘K now also lists the always-listed 常用 types the package holds none of, the AI group for example. The PR body's ⌘K paragraph says so. This is wording only.
- **N3 — instrument: superseded runs read as failures.** `pr-state.mjs` reads `check-runs?filter=latest`, which keeps the newest run per name *per check suite*. A PR-body edit starts a new suite, so the superseded 2026-11-25T19:11Z PR-body guards failure is still counted. l1-face prints "1 failed" at a head whose newest run of every name is green. No open card covers this (searched). It is the seat's to file under `filing-gate.md`, or to drop; it does not bear on this PR.

### Landing

- The zone lands it: Tier S, not governed, ACCEPT at `ff794532`, every check green taking the newest run per name. K = 10 < 15, so there is no main merge first.
- After the merge, the zone files:
  - F1–F3 (proposal §3.10, card Notes);
  - the Q3 retirement card (with N1's fact).
